name: Good Deeds
overview: Scripture teaches that good deeds are an essential expression of genuine faith, shining as a testimony that glorifies God (Matthew 5:16). However, believers are warned against performing acts of righteousness for human approval, as true reward comes from the Father in heaven (Matthew 6:1). While good deeds reflect a transformed heart and faith in Christ, salvation itself is by grace through faith, not by works (Ephesians 2:8; John 3:16). James emphasizes that faith without accompanying works is incomplete, underscoring that good deeds demonstrate the reality of saving faith (James 2:14).
